name: Bitter Rivals
summary: Marleth Barleybrew asks you to replace a cask of Thunder Ale at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos with her family's brew.

sections.title: A Taste of Competition
sections.body: The Barleybrews have long begrudged the Thunderbrews the fame of their distillery. Marleth respects its ale, but she cannot abide Dun Morogh knowing only Thunderbrew. She means to change local tastes with her family's fiery Barleybrew Scalder.

sections.title: Cellar Subterfuge
sections.body: Beneath the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, aging casks fill a basement storeroom. A guard watches near the Thunderbrews' prized reserve. Draw him away, then secretly switch the barrels.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Bitter Rivals?
faq.answer: Marleth Barleybrew gives you the work. She wants her family's brewing craft to rival the famed ale of the Thunderbrew Distillery.

faq.q: Where is the Thunderbrew cellar located?
aliases: how to get to distillery cellar
faq.answer: The cellar lies beneath the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Its stairs are behind a table in the kitchen.
Barleybrew Scalder is Marleth Barleybrew's potent house ale. She hopes Kharanos patrons will recognize her skill when they taste it in place of Thunder Ale.

faq.q: How do you bypass the guard watching the barrels?
faq.answer: The Thunderbrew guard in the basement hints at what might draw his attention. Distract him, then use the chance to switch the barrels.

faq.q: Why are the Barleybrews and Thunderbrews feuding?
faq.answer: The feud springs from dwarven pride in their craft. The Thunderbrews dominate Kharanos taverns, and the Barleybrews want to prove their recipes are just as good, or better.
After you place the cask of Barleybrew Scalder, you return to Marleth and report your success.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know brewing carries prestige to rival blacksmithing. A feud over rival ales suits the snows of Dun Morogh.
As a rogue, you know how to slip into a guarded cellar, distract a sentry, and switch contraband. Here, the prize is beer instead of gold.
As an Alliance traveler, you pass through Kharanos, Dun Morogh's cultural and logistical hub. Local disputes at the inn often draw recruits in.
